articles.title: Introducing the Grid Protectors Program
articles.summary: OpenAI’s Grid Protectors Program will work with utilities to help future compute campuses support grid reliability and protect consumer electricity costs.

articles.title: LifeVal
articles.summary: Introducing LifeVal, a benchmark measuring how well AI helps people complete everyday tasks, from finding childcare to managing finances and government paperwork.

articles.title: Qodo builds context into AI code review with Codex
articles.summary: Qodo brings company knowledge and coding standards into Codex, helping developers catch P0 issues across repositories before opening a pull request.

articles.title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
articles.summary: OpenAI will honor a shared robots.txt signal to help website operators communicate their AI training preferences to participating providers.

articles.title: Community safety report and new protections for teens
articles.summary: OpenAI is strengthening violence prevention in ChatGPT with expanded safeguards, earlier interventions, and a new commitment to public safety reporting.

articles.title: Fair use benefits everyone
articles.summary: OpenAI shares excerpts from court briefs by creators, academics, accessibility advocates, and legal experts, among others, on how fair use supports AI training and innovation.
